post.summary: Situation 2 · Needs her yes, Instant club
post.description: Leaves a game needing only the protagonist's yes, at a club that books at once: the soonest card of hers in the group and sport that her deck shows — one with 0:02:00 hours left before its book-by, where there is one — with enough of the people dealt it beside her saying yes — each through the yes their own phone runs. Her yes then fills it: a charge, *It's a game!*, then Home. With no such card, the proposer deals first.

SearchMode.title: SearchMode
SearchMode.description:
What kind of game this is. **Two values, never three.**

``PlayIntent`` is a player's declaration and has three values; this is the
*game's* kind — a Games card is competitive or for fun — and has two. The
arities differ on purpose, so the likeliest bug in reading one as the other
is a type error rather than a paragraph in a document.

It picks the level window's tolerance (``matchmaking/domain/level_window.py``)
and nothing else here.

open_seats.description: Seats nobody is In on yet, this player's yes counted. Nought on a game that booked — and on a full game an On request club has still to confirm. A payment that could not be held opens its seat again.

booked.description: Present when this yes booked the game: every seat was charged, and the booking and its Game are open. `null` otherwise.

waiting_for_the_club.title: Waiting For The Club
waiting_for_the_club.description: This yes filled the game at an **On request** club: it went to the club, which confirms it within its time to confirm, and nobody pays until it does — the charge and *It's a game!* follow its yes. The game is on Home as `WAITING_FOR_THE_CLUB`.

your_payment.description: Present when **this player's** share could not be held: nobody paid and the game did not book. `null` otherwise — including when somebody else's could not, which leaves `open_seats` above nought.

refusal.description: `AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` — the bank wants the player to confirm; `DECLINED` — confirm with another card; `TERMS_NEEDED` — accept the terms again, then say yes; `NO_METHOD` — save a method, then say yes.
